association: Same predicted class; gated max-cardinality Hungarian on raw unit-direction angular distance; ambiguous nearest row/column rejected; inactive/invalid directions excluded. Raw association reused. No GT or future input.
gate_selection: Fixed engineering prior before new validation comparison; no grid/search; freeze after validation QA, no evaluation tuning.
reset: File start, chunk change, missing adjacent frame, inactive predecessor, class change, rejected association -> raw
vectors: Original unnormalized network xyz; normalize only for angular association; polar output atan2 with frozen integer-degree rounding
shared_mask: Both smooth and fused candidates must be finite and nonzero; identical shared mask. C0 smoothing receives zero velocity, never random untrained head.
raw_regression_gate: 100 validation / 200 evaluation files, 600 frames / 15 chunks, historical CSV byte equality and all official scores <=1e-6 absolute delta. No comparison on regression failure.
official: SHA-pinned DCASE2023 core, micro primary, macro sensitivity; 60 seconds, 10fps
sed: 100ms class-time boolean activity, union across output slots; argmax per slot and max probability > original threshold .5; micro and macro across all 14 classes; no AP from CSV
gt_matching: Scoring only: frame/class Hungarian angular cost without rejection; GT key file/frame/class/source; report all GT and all matched denominators. Not official LR_CD.
motion: Reuse contiguous GT source segments: dynamic if any adjacent angular step >1e-6 degrees; static if >=2 frames and no moving step; singleton unobservable. Verify existing source-frame tables against metadata and regenerated labels.
overlap: same_class if another same-class GT at frame; different_class if another class GT; single otherwise; same_class takes priority, counts exhaustive
boundary_diagnostic: GT segment first/last 3 frames, overlapping counted once; scoring only
turn_diagnostic: Adjacent GT displacement vectors turn >=45deg with both steps >1e-6; sudden step angular distance >=10deg; GT diagnostic only, never decoder input
cases: Before scoring: lexicographically first eligible file/source with >=20 frames in each static/dynamic/overlap/turn category; additionally largest recording-level fusion-minus-smoothing LE failure per seed, explicitly worst-case selected and not representative
uncertainty: Paired seed differences; mean and sample SD ddof=1, no frame-independent significance; recording variation descriptive, no bootstrap p-values
evaluation: Previously inspected in historical development; one frozen exploratory comparison, not pristine holdout
prior: https://eurasip.org/Proceedings/Eusipco/Eusipco2023/pdfs/0000236.pdf equation 3; inspired controlled comparison, not full reproduction
